{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) to counteract overconfidence bias.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates > ±15% from 30-day moving average, adjust toward the average by 50% of the deviation.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true outcomes when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) — weight recent 5-day true values more heavily in next forecast.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with a 30-day exponential decay filter to avoid overreaction to short-term noise.",
    "If true outcome is consistently higher than forecast over 3 consecutive days, shift forecast upward by 2-3% per day to capture momentum.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 5% to reflect bullish sentiment alignment."
  ]
}
